invariants.text: Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The stock quantity of a product must be non-negative.
A bulk update operation that changes the stock quantity of multiple products must succeed entirely or fail entirely as a single transaction.
If any product in a bulk update operation has a stock quantity that is negative, the entire operation must fail.
The sum of the stock quantities of all products after a bulk update must not exceed the maximum allowed total stock quantity.
